statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations
The patient has a history of transient cerebral ischemic attacks
There is concern for undiagnosed paroxysmal atrial fibrillation as a potential embolic source
The service was ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period
The service aims to guide anticoagulation therapy and rate control management
The diagnosis codes are G45.9, I48.91, and R00.2
The denial reason code is CO-197
The denial is based on required precertification or authorization not being obtained prior to the service date
